Do Not Sell My Personal Information

Snov.io complies with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and is always ready to assist California residents in exercising their rights granted by the statute. If you are a California resident, the CCPA permits you to request to opt-out of the “sale” of your personal information to third parties.
